description: Keyboard focus in the calendar is lost after selecting a day in another month.
expected_report: Navigating the calendar with the keyboard and pressing Enter on a day of the adjacent month switches the month, the day is focused briefly, then focus is lost when event dots load. Expected: focus stays on the selected day.
difficulty: 286x308 recording, keyboard focus ring is tiny, the change lasts a moment.
